hjust = 1, color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black") ) if (nrow(annot) > 0) { plot <- plot + stat_pvalue_manual(annot, label = "sign", y.position = ymax_exp, step.increase = 0.04, tip.length = 0.01, bracket.shorten = 0.2, vjust = 0.6, bracket.size = 0.5) } return(plot) } ``` ::: ### CI for JE2 Log-transformed CI were compared using a LMM to determine statistical significance with `culture_pair` as fixed effect and experimental date as a random effect (line was singular). All pairwise contrasts were performed and adjusted for multiple comparisons using the Holm method. A `sign` annotation column was created to indicate which comparisons are statistically significant with p<0.05. Vertical brackets represent model-predicted mean values and confidence intervals (± 2 × SEM), back-transformed to the original response scale. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Calculate Competition
